```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
  SELECT child_code AS code, qty AS total_qty
  FROM u_composition
  WHERE parent_kind = 'model' AND parent_code = 'ER5-140GRY78-0757'
    AND child_kind = 'component'
    AND valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= valid_to)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.child_code, b.total_qty * c.qty
  FROM bom b
  JOIN component comp ON comp.component_code = b.code AND comp.is_assembly = true
  JOIN u_composition c
    ON c.parent_kind = 'component' AND c.parent_code = b.code
   AND c.child_kind = 'component'
   AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) AS units_needed
FROM bom
WHERE code = 'LEG-369-OAK-02362';
```

WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    -- Start from the target model
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c.parent_code = 'TE1-120WAL55-0055'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively expand assembly components
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        b.qty * c.qty AS qty
    FROM bom b
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON b.child_kind = 'component'
     AND b.child_code = c.parent_code
     AND c.parent_kind = 'component'
     AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
     AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    JOIN component comp
      ON b.child_code = comp.component_code
     AND comp.is_assembly = true
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM bom b
JOIN component comp
  ON b.child_code = comp.component_code
 AND b.child_kind = 'component'
WHERE comp.component_code = 'TAB-496-BLK-02765'
  AND comp.is_assembly = false;

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    -- Start with direct components of the model
    SELECT 
        c.child_code,
        c.child_kind,
        c.qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c.parent_code = 'AL4-160OAK35-0520'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively expand assembly components
    SELECT 
        c.child_code,
        c.child_kind,
        c.qty * bt.qty
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN bom_tree bt ON c.parent_kind = bt.child_kind 
                     AND c.parent_code = bt.child_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bt.child_code) AS distinct_parts
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN component comp ON comp.component_code = bt.child_code
WHERE bt.child_kind = 'component'
  AND comp.is_assembly = false;
```

    FROM store
    WHERE store_name = 'Amazon-US-20'

-- 2. Completed order lines in 2025 for that store
lines AS (
    SELECT ol.order_id, ol.line_no, ol.qty, o.order_date, l.sku_id
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN store_cte s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
-- 3. Recursive explosion of each line's SKU down to components
explode AS (
    -- Base: start from each SKU
    SELECT
        ln.order_id,
        ln.line_no,
        ln.order_date,
        ln.qty AS line_qty,
        'sku' AS kind,
        sk.sku_code AS code,
        CAST(ln.qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty_mult
    FROM lines ln
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON sk.sku_id = ln.sku_id

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive step: follow composition edges valid on order date
    SELECT
        e.order_id,
        e.line_no,
        e.order_date,
        e.line_qty,
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_code,
        e.qty_mult * uc.qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN u_composition uc
      ON uc.parent_kind = e.kind
     AND uc.parent_code = e.code
     AND uc.valid_from <= e.order_date
     AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
)
-- 4. Sum quantities of the target part
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty_mult), 0) AS units_consumed
FROM explode

-- order lines for the store in 2024, completed
lines AS (
  SELECT ol.order_id, ol.line_no, ol.qty, o.order_date, l.sku_id
  FROM order_line ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
  JOIN store s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE s.store_name = 'Walmart-UK-22'
    AND o.status = 'completed'
    AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
-- explode BOM recursively from each SKU
explode AS (
  -- start: sku -> children
  SELECT l.order_id, l.line_no, l.order_date,
         uc.child_kind, uc.child_code,
         CAST(l.qty * uc.qty AS BIGINT) AS qty
  FROM lines l
  JOIN u_composition uc
    ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
   AND uc.parent_code = (SELECT sku_code FROM sales_sku WHERE sku_id = l.sku_id)
   AND uc.valid_from <= l.order_date
   AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR l.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
  UNION ALL
  -- model -> component
  SELECT e.order_id, e.line_no, e.order_date,
         uc.child_kind, uc.child_code,
         CAST(e.qty * uc.qty AS BIGINT)
  FROM explode e
  JOIN u_composition uc
    ON uc.parent_kind = e.child_kind
   AND uc.parent_code = e.child_code
   AND uc.valid_from <= e.order_date
   AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
  WHERE e.child_kind IN ('model','component')
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.qty), 0) AS units
FROM explode e
JOIN component c ON c.component_code = e.child_code
WHERE e.child_kind = 'component'
  AND c.is_assembly = false
  AND e.child_code = 'FOO-140-GRY-02859';

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Expand each sold SKU (from completed DE 2025 orders) down to company models, multiplying quantities through bundles
sku_units AS (
    SELECT l.sku_id, SUM(ol.qty) AS units
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN store s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'DE'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY l.sku_id
),
-- Recursive expansion: start from SKUs, walk composition edges to models
expansion AS (
    -- base: SKU level
    SELECT su.sku_id AS root_sku, su.units AS qty, 'sku' AS kind, sk.sku_code AS code
    FROM sku_units su
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON sk.sku_id = su.sku_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.root_sku, e.qty * c.qty, c.child_kind, c.child_code
    FROM expansion e
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_kind = e.kind
     AND c.parent_code = e.code
     AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
     AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)
    WHERE e.kind IN ('sku', 'model')
)
SELECT cm.model_code
FROM expansion e
JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_code = e.code
WHERE e.kind = 'model'
GROUP BY cm.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(e.qty) DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH RECURSIVE sku_to_model AS (
    -- Direct SKU to model mappings (non-bundle SKUs)
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        m.model_id,
        m.model_code,
        uc.qty AS qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = s.sku_code 
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
    JOIN company_model m ON m.model_code = uc.child_code
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
      AND uc.valid_from <= '2024-12-31'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs, then to models
    SELECT 
        b.sku_id,
        b.sku_code,
        m.model_id,
        m.model_code,
        uc_bundle.qty * uc_item.qty AS qty
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition uc_bundle 
        ON uc_bundle.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc_bundle.parent_code = b.sku_code 
        AND uc_bundle.child_kind = 'sku'
    JOIN sales_sku item ON item.sku_code = uc_bundle.child_code
    JOIN u_composition uc_item 
        ON uc_item.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc_item.parent_code = item.sku_code 
        AND uc_item.child_kind = 'model'
    JOIN company_model m ON m.model_code = uc_item.child_code
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true
      AND item.is_bundle = false
      AND uc_bundle.valid_from <= '2024-12-31'
      AND (uc_bundle.valid_to IS NULL OR uc_bundle.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')
      AND uc_item.valid_from <= '2024-12-31'
      AND (uc_item.valid_to IS NULL OR uc_item.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')
)
SELECT 
    sm.model_code,
    SUM(ol.qty * sm.qty) AS total_units
FROM orders o
JOIN store st ON o.store_id = st.store_id AND st.country = 'CA'
JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id

GROUP BY sm.model_code
ORDER BY total_units DESC

WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: find all company models that directly contain TAB-548-GRY-00039
    SELECT 
        c.model_id,
        c.model_code,
        comp.component_code AS child_code,
        uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN company_model c ON uc.parent_code = c.model_code AND uc.parent_kind = 'model'
    JOIN component comp ON uc.child_code = comp.component_code AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
    WHERE comp.component_code = 'TAB-548-GRY-00039'
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: follow through sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        be.model_id,
        be.model_code,
        uc.child_code,
        be.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_code = be.child_code AND uc.parent_kind = 'component'
    JOIN component comp ON uc.child_code = comp.component_code AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
    WHERE comp.is_assembly = false
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),

-- Also need to handle the case where TAB-548-GRY-00039 is inside an assembly that is inside a model
model_to_assembly AS (
    -- Find assemblies that contain TAB-548-GRY-00039 (directly or nested)
    SELECT 
        uc.parent_code AS assembly_code,
        uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN component comp ON uc.child_code = comp.component_code AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
    WHERE comp.component_code = 'TAB-548-GRY-00039'
      AND uc.parent_kind = 'component'
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        uc.parent_code AS assembly_code,
        mta.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_to_assembly mta
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.child_code = mta.assembly_code AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
    JOIN component comp ON uc.parent_code = comp.component_code AND uc.parent_kind = 'component'
    WHERE comp.is_assembly = true
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),

-- Find models that contain those assemblies
models_with_assembly AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.model_id,
        c.model_code
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN company_model c ON uc.parent_code = c.model_code AND uc.parent_kind = 'model'
    JOIN model_to_assembly mta ON uc.child_code = mta.assembly_code AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)

-- Count distinct models
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT model_id) AS model_count
FROM (
    SELECT model_id FROM bom_explosion
    UNION
    SELECT model_id FROM models_with_assembly
) all_models

WITH RECURSIVE bom_path AS (
    -- Base case: find all company models that directly contain ASM-376-03302
    SELECT 
        c.component_code AS child_code,
        cm.model_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN component c ON uc.child_kind = 'component' AND uc.child_code = c.component_code
    JOIN company_model cm ON uc.parent_kind = 'model' AND uc.parent_code = cm.model_code
    WHERE uc.child_code = 'ASM-376-03302'
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: follow parent components upward
    SELECT 
        c.component_code AS child_code,
        bp.model_code AS model_code,
        bp.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_path bp
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.child_kind = 'component' AND uc.child_code = bp.child_code
    JOIN component c ON uc.parent_kind = 'component' AND uc.parent_code = c.component_code
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
model_direct AS (
    -- Models with direct component usage
    SELECT DISTINCT model_code FROM bom_path
),
model_via_assembly AS (
    -- Models where assembly containing ASM-376-03302 is used
    SELECT DISTINCT cm.model_code
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN component c ON uc.child_kind = 'component' AND uc.child_code = c.component_code
    JOIN company_model cm ON uc.parent_kind = 'model' AND uc.parent_code = cm.model_code
    JOIN bom_path bp ON c.component_code = bp.child_code
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT model_code FROM model_direct
UNION
SELECT model_code FROM model_via_assembly
ORDER BY model_code;

    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = s.sku_code 
        AND c.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND c.child_kind = 'model'
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
        AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' 
        AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all paths from models down through components
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base: models to their direct components
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_id,
        sm.sku_code,
        sm.model_code,
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        sm.model_qty * c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = sm.model_code 
        AND c.parent_kind = 'model' 
        AND c.child_kind = 'component'
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' 
        AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: assemblies to their children
    SELECT 
        be.sku_id,
        be.sku_code,
        be.model_code,
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        be.total_qty * c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN component p ON p.component_code = be.component_code
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = be.component_code 
        AND c.parent_kind = 'component' 
        AND c.child_kind = 'component'
    WHERE p.is_assembly = true
        AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' 
        AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
-- Count distinct non-bundle SKUs that contain the target part
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sku_id) AS sku_count
FROM bom_explosion be
JOIN component c ON c.component_code = be.component_code
WHERE c.component_code = 'GEA-767-OAK-00892'

    SELECT 
        c.parent_kind,
        c.parent_code,
        c.child_kind,

        c.qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.child_kind = 'component'

      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')

    -- Recursive case: walk up the BOM
    SELECT 
        c.parent_kind,
        c.parent_code,
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty * b.qty
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN bom b ON c.child_kind = b.parent_kind AND c.child_code = b.parent_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),
-- Find all models that contain the part (at any level)
models_with_part AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT parent_code AS model_code
    FROM bom
    WHERE parent_kind = 'model'
),
-- Find all non-bundle SKUs that map to those models
skus_from_models AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.parent_code AS sku_code
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN models_with_part m ON c.child_code = m.model_code
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.child_kind = 'model'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),
-- Also find SKUs that contain other SKUs (bundle items) that map to those models
-- Need to recurse through bundle SKUs to find item SKUs that map to models
bundle_items AS (
    -- Direct item SKUs in bundles that map to models with the part
    SELECT DISTINCT c.parent_code AS bundle_sku_code, c.child_code AS item_sku_code
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),
-- Get all non-bundle SKUs (either direct or as bundle items)
all_non_bundle_skus AS (
    -- Direct non-bundle SKUs mapping to models
    SELECT s.sku_code
    FROM skus_from_models s
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON s.sku_code = sk.sku_code
    WHERE sk.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION
    
    -- Non-bundle item SKUs inside bundles that map to models
    SELECT bi.item_sku_code AS sku_code
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN skus_from_models sm ON bi.bundle_sku_code = sm.sku_code
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON bi.item_sku_code = sk.sku_code
    WHERE sk.is_bundle = false
)

WITH RECURSIVE

-- First, find all SKUs (direct or inside bundles) that map to model AE2-160GRY74-0268
-- Need to handle: direct SKU->model edges and bundle SKU->item SKU->model paths

-- Step 1: Get all direct SKU to model compositions valid in 2025
direct_sku_model AS (
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS sku_code,
        c.child_code AS model_code,
        c.qty AS model_qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.child_kind = 'model'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2025-12-31'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2025-01-01')
),

-- Step 2: Get bundle to item SKU compositions (always valid)
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS bundle_sku_code,
        c.child_code AS item_sku_code,
        c.qty AS item_qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
),

-- Step 3: Find all SKUs that map to our target model, with total model quantity per SKU
sku_to_model AS (
    -- Direct mappings
    SELECT 
        d.sku_code,
        d.model_code,
        d.model_qty AS total_model_qty
    FROM direct_sku_model d
    WHERE d.model_code = 'AE2-160GRY74-0268'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle item mappings: bundle -> item SKU -> model
    SELECT 
        b.bundle_sku_code AS sku_code,
        d.model_code,
        b.item_qty * d.model_qty AS total_model_qty
    FROM bundle_items b
    JOIN direct_sku_model d ON b.item_sku_code = d.sku_code
    WHERE d.model_code = 'AE2-160GRY74-0268'
),

-- Step 4: Get all completed orders in 2025 with their SKUs and quantities
completed_orders_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        l.sku_id,
        sk.sku_code
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON l.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
)

-- Final: Sum up all model units sold
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(co.line_qty * sm.total_model_qty), 0)::BIGINT AS total_model_units_sold
FROM completed_orders_2025 co
JOIN sku_to_model sm ON co.sku_code = sm.sku_code

WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find all SKUs that map to the target model (directly or through bundles)
sku_to_model_paths AS (
    -- Direct SKU -> model edges
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        c.qty as sku_model_qty,
        1 as path_multiplier,
        s.sku_code as root_sku_code,
        FALSE as via_bundle
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'model' AND c.child_code = 'VI7-180BLK56-0347'
    WHERE c.valid_from <= '2024-12-31' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model paths
    SELECT 
        s_parent.sku_id,
        s_parent.sku_code,
        c_model.qty as sku_model_qty,
        c_bundle.qty * sp.path_multiplier as path_multiplier,
        sp.root_sku_code,
        TRUE as via_bundle
    FROM sku_to_model_paths sp
    JOIN u_composition c_bundle ON c_bundle.child_kind = 'sku' AND c_bundle.child_code = sp.root_sku_code
        AND c_bundle.parent_kind = 'sku'
    JOIN sales_sku s_parent ON s_parent.sku_code = c_bundle.parent_code AND s_parent.is_bundle = TRUE
    JOIN u_composition c_model ON c_model.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c_model.parent_code = sp.root_sku_code
        AND c_model.child_kind = 'model' AND c_model.child_code = 'VI7-180BLK56-0347'
    WHERE c_bundle.valid_from <= '2024-12-31' AND (c_bundle.valid_to IS NULL OR c_bundle.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')
        AND c_model.valid_from <= '2024-12-31' AND (c_model.valid_to IS NULL OR c_model.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')
        -- Prevent infinite recursion: only follow if we haven't seen this parent before
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM sku_to_model_paths sp2 
            WHERE sp2.sku_code = s_parent.sku_code
        )
),
-- Deduplicate to get unique SKU -> model mappings with total quantity per SKU
sku_model_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        sku_id,
        sku_code,
        SUM(sku_model_qty * path_multiplier) as total_model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sku_to_model_paths
    GROUP BY sku_id, sku_code
),
-- Get all completed orders in 2024 with their line quantities
order_lines_2024 AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty as line_qty
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
        AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
)
-- Calculate total model units sold
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(ol.line_qty * smq.total_model_qty_per_sku), 0)::BIGINT as total_model_units_sold
FROM order_lines_2024 ol
JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
JOIN sku_model_qty smq ON smq.sku_id = l.sku_id

        be.order_date,

        uc.child_kind AS parent_kind,
        uc.child_code AS parent_code,

            WHEN uc.child_kind = 'sku' THEN uc.child_code
            WHEN uc.child_kind = 'model' THEN uc.child_code
            WHEN uc.child_kind = 'component' THEN uc.child_code
        END AS child_code,
        uc.qty AS qty_per_parent,
        be.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty,
        be.depth + 1
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON be.parent_kind = uc.parent_kind 
        AND be.parent_code = uc.parent_code
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= be.order_date

    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON l.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    WHERE ol.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM jp_orders)
),

-- Recursive expansion of SKU compositions
-- We need to expand bundles to get to non-bundle SKUs, then to models
sku_expansion AS (
    -- Base: start with order lines, if bundle we need to expand
    SELECT 
        osq.listing_id,
        osq.line_qty,
        osq.sku_code AS parent_sku_code,
        osq.sku_code AS child_sku_code,
        osq.line_qty AS qty_at_sku_level,
        1 AS depth,
        osq.is_bundle
    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand: if current is a bundle, expand to its children
    SELECT 
        se.listing_id,
        se.line_qty,
        se.child_sku_code AS parent_sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS child_sku_code,
        se.qty_at_sku_level * uc.qty AS qty_at_sku_level,
        se.depth + 1,
        child_sk.is_bundle
    FROM sku_expansion se
    JOIN u_composition uc ON se.child_sku_code = uc.parent_code 
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    JOIN sales_sku child_sk ON uc.child_code = child_sk.sku_code
    WHERE se.is_bundle = true
),

-- Get leaf SKUs (non-bundle) with their total quantities
leaf_sku_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        listing_id,
        child_sku_code AS sku_code,
        SUM(qty_at_sku_level) AS total_qty
    FROM sku_expansion
    WHERE is_bundle = false
    GROUP BY listing_id, child_sku_code
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also include non-bundle SKUs that were never expanded (direct non-bundle sales)
    SELECT 
        osq.listing_id,
        osq.sku_code,
        osq.line_qty AS total_qty
    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    WHERE osq.is_bundle = false
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM sku_expansion se 
          WHERE se.listing_id = osq.listing_id 
            AND se.parent_sku_code = osq.sku_code
      )
),

-- Now map SKUs to company models
sku_model_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        lsq.sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        SUM(lsq.total_qty * uc.qty) AS model_qty
    FROM leaf_sku_qty lsq
    JOIN u_composition uc ON lsq.sku_code = uc.parent_code
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    GROUP BY lsq.sku_code, uc.child_code
)

SELECT model_code
FROM sku_model_qty
GROUP BY model_code
ORDER BY SUM(model_qty) DESC
LIMIT 3;

    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND c.parent_code = ol.sku_code
        AND c.valid_from <= ol.order_date

        be.child_code AS parent_code,
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,

        be.depth + 1
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = be.child_kind 
        AND c.parent_code = be.child_code
        AND c.valid_from <= be.order_date 
        AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= c.valid_to)
    WHERE be.child_kind IN ('model', 'component')

    SELECT

    -- This is already handled by recursion since model->component is in the recursive step

-- We need to find all paths that end at parts.
